summary: CGI Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer on Form 20-F (the US equivalent of a domestic annual filing), furnished a Form 6-K covering its fiscal year ended September 30, 2026, with 18 documents including MD&A, audited consolidated financial statements, a November 11, 2026 results press release, and PricewaterhouseCoopers' auditor consent. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural or regulatory clock is disclosed; the exhibits are incorporated by reference into Form S-8 registrations. This is a routine annual reporting package, so there is no special-situation or risk-arbitrage angle to track.
